items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Although Ted Block is a fine doctor. Has a good heart.

ctx.x: I've passed it. Well, it's beautiful.

If the rates are a little bit out on some people, but with Medicare you can make a go of it. You know, Medicare has been very kind of me because those doctors let you have a friend, I'm telling you. Although Ted Block is a fine doctor. Has a good heart. So what you see, you see me with wide trousers on, but I can show you some. Now I try. My daughter is the one. Well, she's up to date. She's a beautiful girl. She was here this morning. She wants her daddy to be just so. And her friends, that's why I'm living in…
